summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K reporting it terminated a binding term sheet with Lucky Whale Production Limited to form a JV for an Israeli hyperscale data center. The due diligence revealed a temporary suspension of electricity approvals by Israeli authorities, making the project infeasible. No pricing, premium, or advisory details were disclosed. The registrant is the filer who walked away; the counterparty is unaffiliated. This is a deal-termination special situation; the risk-arb angle is moot as no definitive agreement existed and no break fee is stated.
